text:
emma_cs: Heads-up: MistralCare has an APAC demo tomorrow 9:00 SGT and they hit 429s during the last pilot. Can we provision a temporary APAC egress allowlist + a short QPS window (they want ~600 QPS burst) for 6 hours? Also need to preserve x-mistral-session header (they rely on it for routing). Who can own the change and rollback?

sophia_netops: Can you paste the customer CIDRs and the exact UTC window? Is this edge-level allowlist or control-plane header passthrough?

emma_cs: CIDRs (redacted): 203.0.113.45/32, 198.51.100.0/24
Window: 2026-03-25 01:00 -> 07:00 UTC (9:00 -> 15:00 SGT)
Edge-level allowlist + header forwarding required. Project slug: mistralcare-prod.

raj_eng: ok I can do the policy. Plan: create ephemeral apac policy with auto-revoke at 07:00 UTC, bump rate-window for that policy to allow 600 QPS burst (we'll keep steady qps lower to protect shared pools). I'll canary it to apac-edge-1 first.

olivia_ops: +1 to auto-revoke. Can we make the policy taggable so finance can see the pilot cost? Also add an alert to #eng-sre if 429 rate > 1% after apply.

raj_eng: suggested command to create the policy (run from deploy shell):

```
# ephemeral allowlist + qps window for demo
redwoodctl policies create \
  --name mistralcare-apac-demo \
  --project mistralcare-prod \
  --region apac \
  --cidrs 203.0.113.45/32,198.51.100.0/24 \
  --header-forward x-mistral-session \
  --qps 100 --burst 600 \
  --expires 2026-03-25T07:00:00Z \
  --tags demo,mistralcare,auto-revoke
```

raj_eng: I'll apply to apac-edge-1 in canary and monitor for 15m, then roll to apac-edge-2. Will add a Grafana panel and an alert.

deploy-bot: policy mistralcare-apac-demo (id edge-policy-1123) created in apac-edge-1 (canary).

sophia_netops: firewall rule + proxy header pass-through configured on apac-proxy-03. Please run a quick smoke curl from your side to validate header preserved:

```
curl -v -H \"x-mistral-session: test-123\" https://apac-edge-01.redwood-inference.example/mistralcare/health
```

emma_cs: running the curl now, I'll paste results in 5m. Thanks team :pray: 

emma_cs: quick check-in: 200 OK, header echoed back, no 429s in initial 10m. Demo lead confirmed latency is stable.

olivia_ops: Added billing tag and created slack alert to #eng-sre for >1% 429 rate. Auto-revoke scheduled.

deploy-bot: canary rolled to apac-edge-2. policy edge-policy-1123 now active across apac edges.

raj_eng: leaving monitoring on for 3 hours post-demo and then will remove the extra burst (qps -> 20, burst -> 100) before auto-revoke.

deploy-bot: policy edge-policy-1123 auto-revoked at 2026-03-25T07:00:05Z (expiry reached).

emma_cs: closing the loop — demo completed, customer reported stable experience. We'll log this as a pilot in the account health sheet and follow up about steady-state quota increase in renewal conversation. :tada:
